description: List recent earthquakes worldwide from the USGS feed. Filter by minimum magnitude, look-back window in days, and optionally a bounding box or a point+radius (km). Returns magnitude, place, time, depth and coordinates.

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7, max 30).

lat.description: Optional center latitude for a radius search.

limit.description: Maximum number of quakes to return.

lon.description: Optional center longitude for a radius search.

min_magnitude.description: Only return quakes at or above this magnitude.

radius_km.description: Radius in km around lat/lon (requires lat+lon).

name: earthquakes
title: Earthquakes
